physical.target: LineAttack with catalogue melee range in MU, actual anatomy/armor/contact; one hit.
physical.cadence: CaelumAttackRules.Duration: BASE_TICS adjusted by attributes and weapon/glove weight versus capacity.
physical.costs: Catalogue primary/secondary Air, actor consumption and heat multipliers; charged cost/damage x2.
physical.wear: Damage-based wear on captured actual item; charge captured/consumed when preparation is accepted, restored only for the pending impact calculation.
physical.interruptions: Existing menus, immobilization, cooldown, item/identity changes and pending-action guards.

magic.target: Essence effect on struck body; Book homes; Statuette area is authored explosion, charged area x2.
magic.cadence: Existing casting/recovery clock, attributes and implement weight.
magic.costs: Base Anima x tier 1/1.6/2.5 x charge 1/2 / Eloquence divisor, paid once per cast.
magic.wear: Captured exact item and existing successful-effect wear; no extra payment per Bell projectile.
magic.interruptions: Existing pending cast, insufficient Anima, cooldown, menus, immobilization and item changes.

ranged.target: Native projectile, range in catalogue meters converted to MU; authored penetration exclusions; shotgun twelve pellets per cartridge.
ranged.cadence: Physical preparation/recovery; empty-magazine Fire requests idempotent reload.
ranged.costs: One ammunition unit and existing Air per shot; independent magazines and migration unchanged.
ranged.wear: Existing item-ID wear routing, independent of number of pellets/victims.
ranged.interruptions: Existing attack guards; active reload blocks shot until completion.

charge.cadence: 2 s base adjusted by attack/casting multiplier; 3 s prepared window.
charge.costs: No attack payment until execution; next accepted attack pays x2.
charge.interruptions: Item mismatch, immobilization, block and existing cancellation; held R does not restart after expiry.

reload.cadence: CaelumRangedRules reload duration and existing progress multiplier.
reload.costs: Existing reserve/capacity rule and firearm muscular heat; repeated requests do not begin heat again.
reload.interruptions: Item mismatch, block, immobilization; empty reserve cannot start.

aim.costs: Existing doubled accuracy/FOV rules; no new charge.
aim.interruptions: Existing reload, block, charge and item-change rules.

block.costs: Existing shield/gauntlet defense and received-hit resource rules.
block.interruptions: Compatible equipment required; ordinary attacks cancel block; utility stream is interrupted by block.

sweep.target: Nearby valid enemies, line of sight, primary range; one hit per body.
sweep.cadence: Primary duration, one execution per Zoom press.
sweep.costs: 3x primary Air once; charged 6x, never per body.
sweep.wear: Actual successful-hit wear; captured item ID.
sweep.interruptions: Existing cooldown, resource, cast, charge and immobilization guards.

javelin.target: Close melee target or native thrown projectile.
javelin.cadence: Existing physical cycle; secondary input latched.
javelin.wear: One durability on a real throw; ordinary damage-based wear on fallback.
javelin.interruptions: Existing physical guards and exact-item identity.

stream.target: Bounded visible contact stream; existing #162 range/heat rules.
stream.cadence: Held input, continuous cost with existing contact cadence.
stream.costs: Anima per second from shared breath rules and actor modifiers.
stream.wear: Contact damage-based wear, no free repeated victim payment.
stream.interruptions: Release, block, immobilization, depleted Anima, equipment change.

bolas.target: Native projectile and existing restraint eligibility.
bolas.cadence: AltFire preparation to authored limit; Fire throw.
bolas.costs: Existing Air once; actual item transferred out of inventory.
